renewal-authority.meaning: Nonempty text explicitly authorizes replacing an existing invalid pair. A valid existing pair is kept even when authority is supplied.

dry-run.meaning: Report root creation or replacement without writing a pair; still observe a valid standing pair.

primitive.meaning: The certificate operation (ensure_root), or error for the stop-level exception arm.

role.meaning: Normalized appliance profile used by the certificate operation.

changed.meaning: Whether the primitive reports a change; some failure paths may report partial effects.

dry_run.meaning: Whether the primitive returned a dry-run receipt; a refusal before planning can report false.

state_generation.meaning: Reported generation of the certificate state, or 0 when not available.

client_reinstall_required.meaning: Whether clients must reinstall trust for the reported operation.

ca_fingerprint.meaning: SHA-256 fingerprint reported for the House CA certificate.

ca_not_after.meaning: OpenSSL notAfter text for the House CA certificate.

renewal_authority.meaning: Whether a dry-run creation or renewal had nonempty authority.

renewed.meaning: Whether the newly written pair replaced prior material.

plan.meaning: Ordered action names describing the proposed operation.

proof.meaning: Evidence named by the primitive for this outcome.
